answer: At dawn, each agent posts a refundable bond before its key can speak. Peers then issue short challenge packets; only after several independent successes does the bond unlock into spendable stake. A sybil farm flooding the jetty of admissions must front capital per clone and survive staggered audits that flag lockstep failures. Missed replies burn the bond like yarrow dried for fuel—cheap to sketch one fake identity, ruinous to keep a swarm alive.
